basic_info.description: First time in the market in over 50 years!  Bright two bedroom, one bathroom home with lovely architectural details that include hardwood floors, high ceilings, arched period detailed doorways, and wood trim. The living room has parquet floors, a stately fireplace, period sconces, a picture window with views of the Pacific and the coastline, and a barrel ceiling.  The formal dining room opens directly to the living room.  The kitchen has updated appliances and an eat-in dining area with a built-in hutch and ample cabinet space. There are two bedrooms in the rear of the home with a garden view.  A spacious vintage split bathroom with tub and shower is located on this level. There is a family room at the lower level.  A vast garage with a large work area and plenty of space to pursue your hobbies or potential to expand. Access to a private yard and patio with mature plantings. It has a 93 Walk Score, with the shops and restaurants on Taraval only minutes away. Transit is a snap with the L Taraval and the 48 and 66 buses nearby. McCoppin Square is around the corner and Pine Lake Park with its renowned dog park, and Stern Grove, and the free summer concert series is close by.
